name: Enavatuzumab
sponsor: Facet Biotech / PDL BioPharma -> Abbott -> AbbVie Biotherapeutics
agonist_antagonist: inhibits tumour cell growth and induces ADCC; no IL8/cell-death agonism alone, but oligomerisation or FcgR binding converts it into a potent agonist
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: loss of binding to the R56P point mutant; retains binding to W42A
competes_with_TWEAK: NO - barely blocks TWEAK binding (direct competition experiment)
notes: Residue split and the competition result come from GPT review round 1 citing Salzmann 2013 Fig 1A/1F; both papers are paywalled, so NOT independently verified by this project. v1 of this table wrongly assigned both W42 and R56 to this antibody.

name: P4A8
modality: mouse parental mAb; scFv used in immunotoxins
sponsor: academic (Wuerzburg) / Biogen Idec lineage; Tehran Univ. Med. Sci. for the immunotoxins
agonist_antagonist: not agonistic alone; strongly agonistic after oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: implied by immunotoxin activity, not directly measured in the sources read
epitope_method: loss of binding to the W42A point mutant; retains binding to R56P
notes: Same caveat as FNB-001. Key counter-example: W42 is NOT buried by TWEAK in the M2 model, yet this antibody does compete - so an unburied sensitive residue does not imply a non-competitive antibody.

name: BIIB036
agonist_antagonist: agonist: induces Fn14 signalling and apoptosis in vitro; needs full Fc effector function and higher valency for maximal in vivo effect
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: binds Fn14 specifically, not other TNFR family members; no residue mapping of this humanized form in the sources read
notes: Same lineage as FNB-002 (P4A8 humanized by CDR grafting, per GPT review citing Michaelson 2011; the abstract alone does not state this). Counted as one lineage, not an independent epitope finding.

name: ITEM-4
modality: mouse mAb (research reagent); scaffold for several conjugates
agonist_antagonist: not characterised as agonist/antagonist in the sources read
internalization_evidence: YES: ITEM4-rGel internalises specifically and rapidly (within 2 h) in Fn14-positive T-24 cells, not in Fn14-deficient fibroblasts (confocal)
epitope_method: high-affinity binder; no residue mapping in the sources read
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read

name: 18D1
agonist_antagonist: becomes a strong agonist on oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: blocks TWEAK binding at 0.2-2 ug/ml; binds W42A and R56P efficiently, so its epitope differs from both LIN-19.2.1 and LIN-P4A8
notes: ADCC-enhanced and ADCC-defective variants both reduced liver metastasis in a human colon carcinoma xenograft; only the ADCC-enhanced variant suppressed lung metastasis in RENCA.

name: 4G5
agonist_antagonist: becomes a strong agonist on oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: blocks TWEAK binding at 0.2-2 ug/ml; binds W42A and R56P efficiently

name: 5B6
agonist_antagonist: becomes a strong agonist on oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: does NOT efficiently block TWEAK binding; binds W42A and R56P efficiently
notes: Binds Fn14 without blocking TWEAK, so its epitope is likely away from the TWEAK footprint.

name: TWEAKR-KSPi-ADC1 / ADC2
binder_lineage_id: not stated in the sources read
modality: ADC (mAb + small-molecule kinesin spindle protein inhibitor)
agonist_antagonist: not characterised in the sources read
internalization_evidence: implied by ADC mechanism (payload must be internalised); not directly measured in the abstract
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: THE Fn14 ADC that v1 of this table missed, because Bayer indexes the target as TWEAKR, not Fn14. Strong efficacy in a TWEAKR-expressing CT26 COLON cancer model; at suboptimal doses it worked only in immunocompetent mice, indicating an additional immunological mechanism. Most CRC-relevant entry in this table.

name: GrB-Fc-IT4
binder_lineage_id: LIN-ITEM4 (humanized scFv; relationship stated in review, not in the abstract)
modality: granzyme B fusion (human serine protease payload)
agonist_antagonist: not characterised in the sources read
internalization_evidence: reported in the sources cited by the review; the abstract states high affinity and selective cytotoxicity
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: Uses a humanized anti-Fn14 single-chain antibody as the targeting moiety. Also identified Fn14 as overexpressed in triple-negative breast cancer.

name: GrB-TWEAK
modality: granzyme B fused to the TWEAK ligand
agonist_antagonist: ligand-based, so expected to engage the TWEAK site itself
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
verification_status: Listed for completeness: a ligand-targeted construct, not an antibody epitope.

name: hSGZ
agonist_antagonist: not characterised in the sources read
internalization_evidence: reported in the sources cited by the review
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: v1 listed this as unverified/unknown provenance; the review states it is built on a humanized ITEM-4 scFv, which is consistent with the same group's other work.
